title: ROB-1474 multi-hypothesis sweep: seven simple rankers x five horizons x long-only/long-short, US and crypto
question: Does any simple price/volume ranker beat seeded random selection, the equal-weight eligible universe and buy-and-hold over the same dates, names, horizon and cost, in an exploration window, and does a pre-registered carry-forward set repeat in one later validation window? Candidates for a separate paper test only; no promotion or deployment claim.

hashes.preregistration_text: this manifest; grid, controls, windows, carry-forward rule and stopping rules below are fixed before any validation read
hashes.supersedes_note: v2 replaces v1 (dc2512f8...) before any validation read and before any look (k stays 0). The v1 exploration run checked only the entry and exit opens of a hold; a crypto token swap with missing sessions in between (price x1000) became a +144,000% outcome. v2 requires every session between entry and exit to exist. All v1 exploration rows stay in the trials ledger flagged superseded. v3 (before any look, k stays 0) changes only run hygiene found in review of the exploration PR: the ledger and carry files are write-once, and a US cache fetched for an earlier period is refused for a longer request (v4, same review: also a cache directory holding CSVs without a recorded request window is refused). The exploration results were produced by the v2 code (exploration_run_code_sha256) and a rerun with the v3 code reproduces every exploration cell metric exactly.

splits.scheme: no fitted parameter. Exploration = decision dates 2021-01-04..2023-12-31 with exit inside that window; features use history from 2019-06. Validation = decision dates 2024-02-01..2024-12-31 with exit inside that window, opened once. The window gap (all of January 2024) exceeds the longest horizon of 20 sessions.

test.exposure_audit: No registered experiment in this repository reads 2024 daily returns of these rankers: ROB-1474 diagnostics used 2022 samples, ROB-1441 is KR, the crypto and US universe packages store listings and candles but compute no returns. Unregistered work outside the repository cannot be ruled out. Crypto candles after 2024-12-31 (holdout files) are never opened, and the exploration command truncates every input at 2023-12-31.
test.seal_rule: One look. A cell is validated only if the exploration run carried it forward under the rule in stopping_rules; the carry list is committed before any 2024 row is read. If no cell is carried forward there is no look and k does not change. The window is never reopened or extended.

candidate_policies.description: 200 seeded random draws of the same decile size from the same eligible names on the same dates (seed s, date index t -> numpy default_rng([s, t])); long_short draws disjoint long and short sets
equal weight over the eligible names on the same dates, same horizon, same per-side cost
SPY (US) or BTCUSDT (crypto) over the same open-to-open interval; the cost-matched excess equals the gross excess
long the top decile (ceil(10% of N)) by ranker score, equal weight, ties by symbol; excess reported over all three controls
long top decile and short bottom decile; reported as net spread, per-leg excess over equal-weight and benchmark (the legs add to the gross spread), and rank against the random long-short distribution

costs_fills.cost_table: us=10,crypto=15 bps per side as in research/stock_selection; same cost on every control
fill_models: fill at the next session open with the stated per-side cost, no slippage or capacity model, shorts assumed borrowable at no cost (diagnostic, not an executable NAV)
terminal exit at last close for a series that ended early; no payout is fabricated

tuning_budget.search: none: the full grid is fixed and every cell is run once and logged in the trials ledger, including cells that fail or carry no information; no cell is added, dropped or re-parameterised after registration

metrics.primary: mean net excess per vintage: long_only = top-decile return minus equal-weight eligible-universe return; long_short = top minus bottom return minus 4 sides of cost
secondary: random-selection rank p = (1 + number of seeds whose mean >= observed) / 201
Newey-West t of the primary series with lags = horizon
per-leg excess over equal-weight and benchmark
family: 140 exploration cells; at most 10 carried-forward validation cells, Bonferroni alpha 0.05 / m on the random-selection rank p

stopping_rules: carry-forward rule (exploration only): net primary mean > 0 AND (long_short OR long-only excess over benchmark > 0) AND Newey-West t >= 2.0 AND random-selection rank p <= 0.05 AND primary mean positive in at least 2 of the 3 exploration years AND at least 100 measured vintages; if more than 10 cells qualify, the 10 with the largest t
validation pass flag per carried cell: net primary mean > 0 AND random-selection rank p <= 0.05 / m; a flag is not a promotion, deployment or live-gate verdict
if no cell is carried forward there is no validation look
any temporal leakage (a feature that reads past the decision close, a window that reads past its end) invalidates the run and needs a new manifest version
no policy, threshold or ranker change from interim results; paper results never select or tune these cells

survivor and point-in-time limits are stated in every report: the US names are a seeded sample of names listed at 2019-12-31 whose prices still exist on a public source, so late-delisted names are mostly absent; crypto includes delisted pairs but terminal exits are optimistic
no scheduling, DB, broker, account, credential, app/ change
